title: Luna
description: A privacy-first Windows voice assistant that runs fully locally — offline wake-word detection with Vosk, speech-to-text via faster-whisper, and interruptible TTS via SAPI5. Handles common commands in ~20ms without any LLM call, falls back to a strict-JSON LLM interpreter for unknown requests, and controls apps, keyboard, and a reused Playwright browser session via an allowlist-only action set.
